description.value: A Victoria landmark since 1913, the Strathcona Hotel sits in the heart of downtown and combines a hotel with nine bars, a live music venue, and a liquor store under one roof. Known locally as 'The Strath,' it draws visitors and locals alike with BC's largest pub, the Sticky Wicket, offering food and live entertainment. A touring cyclist would find it conveniently located in the urban core with on-site evening dining and vibrant nightlife immediately available.
